beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:1f.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. To succeed in this role, this individual should be an enthusiastic and energetic self-starter with strong attention to detail. The ability to multitask and manage multiple projects at the same time will be an important asset. We are seeking a collaborative professional who likes to put forward suggestions and ideas on how to improve the status quo and create best-practices. Teamwork and positivity are key foundations of this growing finance group’s culture and ethos. As Beacon continues to grow, there is significant opportunity for growth, both individually and for the HR department. farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:75a201e1-46.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. FINANCE We're a diverse team who partners and supports the business to enable delivery against our strategic and financial goals. All of our functions have an instrumental role within Farfetch to drive forward a financially sustainable business, ensuring we set the guardrails for financial control and enable financial performance. SÃO PAULO (Brooklin Paulista) Our São Paulo office is situated in Brooklin Paulista, a premier district in the South Zone famous for its ideal balance of major business centers and sophisticated residential neighborhoods. This modern, well-structured location embodies our vision of a vibrant urban hub with a distinct international energy. ROLE The Senior Accounting Analyst will be primarily responsible for leading and ensuring excellence in accounting operations, guaranteeing accurate bookkeeping, compliance with applicable accounting standards (BR GAAP / IFRS), and adherence to the Group’s internal policies. This role will act as a technical reference for the accounting area, with strong involvement in the month-end closing processes, ensuring the quality of information and compliance with company deadlines. You will play an active role in the preparation of Financial Statements, continuous process improvement, and the strengthening of internal controls. You will be the main point of contact for the accounting function in interactions with external auditors, inspections, and regulatory bodies, as well as in supporting other areas of the company with accounting interfaces, including Tax, Billing, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable, in addition to external partners such as the Tax BPO. You will also work closely with global teams, contributing to strategic projects and to the implementation of relevant regulatory and accounting changes.
responsibilities: Act in accounting operations, ensuring accurate bookkeeping and compliance with applicable accounting standards (BR GAAP / IFRS).
Lead and ensure the execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings, meeting deadlines and ensuring the quality and consistency of reported information.
Prepare and review Financial Statements, ensuring accuracy and technical compliance.
Perform analysis of the Financial Statements, identifying significant variances, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Map, document, and promote continuous improvement of accounting and financial processes.
Prepare and review the Digital Accounting Bookkeeping (ECD).
Serve as the main point of contact for external audits, inspections, and inquiries from government authorities.
Provide technical support to other members of the accounting team, the tax team, the Tax BPO, and other company areas with accounting interfaces.
Work closely with the Tax, Billing, Treasury, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable teams, ensuring proper accounting and reconciliation of balances in the Financial Statements.
Collaborate with the Global Tax team to ensure proper tax control, accounting, and reporting.
Implement, monitor, and enhance internal controls, ensuring the integrity and reliability of accounting information.
Support the maintenance and configuration of the ERP system (Dynamics 365), especially on accounting-related matters.
Evaluate the performance of services provided by the Tax BPO, proposing improvements and monitoring their tasks.
Monitor changes in accounting standards and ensure their proper implementation.
Actively participate in strategic projects within the area, such as risk assessments, process reviews, and efficiency initiatives.
Support the implementation of the Tax Reform and its accounting and operational impacts.
